mostWorthwhile.text: Testing both cams was most worthwhile: the comparison made the connection between cam shape and wing movement clear.

leastWorthwhile.text: Trying to attach the rods before mounting the dragon was the least worthwhile moment, though it revealed that the assembly order mattered.
